purpose: Anomalies observed in imported source data. Each is retained unchanged: correcting a record without evidence would be an invention. An administrator may hide or link a listing; the source value is never silently rewritten.

notes.observation: One record carries the name "Grande synagogue d'Alger" and the Arabic name "مسجد ابن فارس" (a mosque), and is classified as a mosque. Its Wikidata item is Q5600070 and its OpenStreetMap object is way/1173895775.
notes.evidence: The listing as imported (name, arabic_name, attributes.wikidata, attributes.osm).
notes.unknown: Why the two labels disagree is not stated by the source; the building may have changed use, or one label may be wrong. This was not resolved.
notes.action: retained unchanged and shown as 'Not verified'; reported by the non_mosque_names check

notes.observation: Seven further records have English names containing 'Chapel' or 'Temple' (for example "Mercy Chapel in Oued Rhiou", "Chapel Omar ibn al-Khattab may Allah be pleased with him in Djelfa") while being classified as mosques.
notes.evidence: The names as imported; the keyword check non_mosque_names in app/services/data_quality.py.
notes.unknown: Whether these are English renderings of an Arabic or French place-of-prayer word, or genuine errors, is not established by the source or by this project.
notes.action: retained unchanged and shown as 'Not verified'; listed by the non_mosque_names check as candidates for human review
